1.consolidated_definition: Asiento para varias personas, montado sobre un armazón de hierro o de madera que permite que todos se mezan a la vez.
1.en_consolidated_definition: Seating arrangement for multiple people, mounted on an iron or wooden framework that allows all to sway simultaneously.
